summary_rationale: TARIL has credible engineering qualifications, a broad product portfolio, record FY26 production, rising capacity and a sharp two-year improvement in sales and operating margins. The financial record remains cyclical, and FY26 operating cash flow was negative despite higher profit as receivables and inventory expanded and supplier credit shortened. Capacity and backward-integration milestones have slipped, product profitability is not disclosed, and large customer orders can create concentration. The business is viable and has real technical advantages, but durable cash conversion and post-expansion returns remain to be demonstrated.
